decision: does the reviewed lazy adapter reproduce the accepted eager Kilosort immediate-prewhitening construction exactly on one ordinary and one state-transition padded Arm-A window on H5?

input.identity_rule: rehash compact metadata and geometry; stat exact binary path/size; do not full-hash the 241 GB binary inside this bounded equality run

source.import_composition: run with the DARTsort interpreter; append the Kilosort site-packages path after the interpreter's own site-packages so DARTsort dependency versions retain precedence; import hashes must still match
source.import_rule: actual H5 runner and imported files must rehash exactly before binary access; real mode also requires the exact frozen interpreter, repository, contract, and appended Kilosort-site paths
source.invocation_rule: execute RUNNER.py with --contract at expected_h5_contract_path, --expected-contract-sha256 equal to the exact contract file hash, a fresh bounded --output, --extra-kilosort-site at expected_h5_kilosort_site, exact hash-bound --review-complete, --dispatch-receipt and --resource-receipt arguments, and --execute-real; argv is preserved in provenance

filter.fft_nt: exact request length independently for every listed request

windows.name: transition
windows.context: spans accepted rounded 0 to +40 um state transition; both boundary conventions remain inside the request

acceptance.primary: for every request, lazy and eager arrays have identical shape [length,384], float32 dtype, finite mask, values and SHA-256
acceptance.clock: local sample zero equals padded_global_start/fs and global request times equal global_frame/fs
acceptance.channels_geometry: channel IDs/order and geometry equal the hash-bound 384x2 input
acceptance.dartsort: preprocessing=none, copy_recording_to_tmpdir=no and work_in_tmpdir=false return the identical lazy recording object with copy_flag=false and work_dir=null
acceptance.positive_control: filtering the 299998-frame central interval alone must differ from cropping frames [60000,359998) from the 419998-frame padded filter; report mismatch count/max error without treating it as a primary failure
acceptance.verdict_pass: all primary comparisons and metadata/import/resource guards pass and the positive control differs
acceptance.verdict_fail: any primary mismatch, nonfinite output, identity/import/resource breach or missing positive-control difference

mismatch_interpretation.primary_mismatch: wrapper/producer/import/request-context incompatibility; stop, preserve exact request and first mismatch coordinates, do not tune tolerance or launch a sort
mismatch_interpretation.positive_control_difference: expected proof that FFT request context matters; not a voltage-quality or motion result
mismatch_interpretation.scope: neither pass nor failure measures sorting benefit, biological identity, purity or full-session performance

resources.read_rule: read each 419998x384 int16 padded window exactly once, sequentially; all comparisons operate on the cached bounded arrays
resources.enforcement: runner lowers RLIMIT_AS and RLIMIT_FSIZE before scientific imports, installs an active wall timer, directs TMPDIR and NUMBA_CACHE_DIR into one owned temporary root watched at 0.1 s intervals, and computes sealed success/failure packet size before writing MANIFEST and COMPLETE; the managed H5 job must independently enforce the same or tighter MemoryMax, RuntimeMaxSec, temporary-filesystem size, CPU and GPU exclusions

output_schema.numeric_policy: save hashes, counts and scalar diagnostics only; never save raw or prewhitened arrays
output_schema.seal_rule: MANIFEST hashes every durable member except COMPLETE; projected bytes including MANIFEST and COMPLETE must fit before either is written; COMPLETE is written last for success or failure
output_schema.outer_launch_receipt: the managed job writes a separate immutable outer receipt even when runner argument, contract, source, environment or release preflight fails before output creation; it binds exact argv, manager_job_id, resource settings, stdout/stderr hashes, exit status, start/end state, contract/runner/review/dispatch/resource hashes, and whether exactly one RESULT.json or FAILURE.json exists in a sealed runner packet

stop_conditions: contract, runner or imported source hash mismatch
input metadata/geometry hash, binary stat/size, frame or clock mismatch
read, memory, wall, thread, output or temporary bound breach
any primary equality mismatch or nonfinite output
any attempted full binary hash, full-recording copy/materialization, GPU/service/sort/RF/holdout access

release.rule: real mode requires immutable focused-review COMPLETE and coordinator-dispatch receipts supplied with exact external hashes; later H5 execution also requires fresh dedup/resource reconciliation but no new generic human approval
release.review_complete: JSON must exactly match review_schema/review_status, include manifest_sha256, and bind reviewed_contract_sha256 plus reviewed_runner_sha256
release.resource_receipt: hash-bound JSON must bind the exact contract and runner plus memory, wall, CPU, temporary, persistent-output and GPU limits; it must identify the independent manager job and a persistent outer receipt path that captures pre-output failures
release.dispatch_contract_binding: dispatch JSON contract_sha256 must equal the command-line expected contract hash; runner_sha256 must equal the contract runner hash; review_complete_sha256 and resource_receipt_sha256 must equal the separately supplied receipt hashes
